name: The Ledge
author: James Beaufort
description:
The Ledge is a short narrative game originally created with RPG Maker MV and adapted for PlayStation Vita using a replacement native runtime incorporating modified LPP-Vita code.
Based on the short story “Man With A Problem” by Donald Honig (1958). Approximate play time is 5–10 minutes.
Content warning: suicide, death and disturbing imagery.
